tests.name: MDCAT — Medical & Dental College Admission Test
acceptedBy: All public and private medical and dental colleges in Pakistan
Provincial admitting universities that administer MDCAT on behalf of PM&DC
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (PKR 9,000 local centres in the 2025 cycle)
tests.frequency: Once a year (2026 test: 20 September, rescheduled from 16 August)
tests.validity: 3 years per the MDCAT-2024 public notice; PM&DC may revise per cycle

syllabus.subject: Biology
topics: Human physiology: circulation, respiration, digestion, homeostasis

syllabus.subject: Chemistry
topics: Physical chemistry: gases, equilibrium, kinetics, thermochemistry
Organic chemistry: hydrocarbons, alcohols, aldehydes, carboxylic acids

syllabus.subject: Physics
topics: Modern physics: electronics, atomic spectra, nuclear physics

syllabus.subject: English
topics: Writing skills: proofreading and sentence structure

syllabus.subject: Logical Reasoning
topics: Course of action and cause-effect analysis

howToApply: Register online on the PM&DC MDCAT portal (mdcat.pmdc.pk) with your CNIC/B-Form
Fill the application form and select your preferred test city and centre
Upload your photograph and required documents as per the instructions
Pay the registration fee and download your admit card before the test date
tests.note: 180 paper-based MCQs in English, 3 hours, no negative marking. Passing: 55% for MBBS, 50% for BDS. Figures per the final PM&DC curriculum (May 2025) applicable to MDCAT 2026.

tests.name: ECAT — Engineering College Admission Test
tests.conductingBody: University of Engineering & Technology (UET) Lahore on behalf of Punjab engineering universities
acceptedBy: UET Lahore and its campuses (Faisalabad, KSK, Narowal, Rachna)
Public-sector engineering universities of Punjab (e.g., UET Taxila, MNS-UET Multan)
tests.fee: PKR 3,000 (Fall 2026 registration, per the official ECAT portal)
tests.frequency: Once a year (June test window; Phase I and Phase II registration)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken (e.g., Fall 2026 session)

syllabus.subject: Physics
topics: Mechanics: motion, force, work and energy

syllabus.subject: Chemistry
topics: Physical chemistry: atomic structure, equilibrium, kinetics
Inorganic chemistry: s- and p-block elements
Organic chemistry: hydrocarbons and functional groups

howToApply: Generate and pay the challan/token on the official ECAT portal (ecat.uet.edu.pk)
Fill the online application form and choose your subject combination
Print your admit card on the announced date from the portal
Appear in the test with your admit card and an original photo ID
tests.note: 10 English questions plus 90 questions split equally (30 each) across three chosen subjects (e.g., Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry). 4 marks per correct answer, no negative marking. Verified from the official ECAT page.

tests.name: NET — NUST Entry Test
acceptedBy: NUST main campus (H-12 Islamabad) for engineering, computing and BS programmes
NUST constituent colleges and campuses (PNEC, MCS, CAE, EME, Risalpur, Karachi)
tests.fee: PKR 5,000 application processing fee (Pakistani nationals; PKR 10,000 for foreign nationals)
tests.frequency: Multiple series per year (3–4 computer-based CBNET series)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission year in which the series is taken
howToApply: Register on the NUST undergraduate admissions portal (ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk)
Select your NET series, test centre and desired programmes
Pay the application processing fee and confirm your registration
Download your admit card and appear in the computer-based test
Check your NET score and apply for programmes within the same admission year
tests.note: Engineering series pattern: 200 MCQs, 3 hours, no negative marking. Other series (Computer Science, Business Studies, Natural Sciences) swap subject sections accordingly.

tests.name: FAST-NUCES Admission Test (NU Test / FUNGAT)
tests.conductingBody: FAST National University of Computer & Emerging Sciences (FAST-NUCES)
acceptedBy: FAST-NUCES campuses: Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Chiniot-Faisalabad, Multan
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (approx. PKR 2,000–2,500 per test; per-campus charges apply)
tests.frequency: Two test rounds per admission cycle (typically July and August)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Register on the FAST admissions portal (admissions.nu.edu.pk) with your email
Fill the online application and select campuses and programmes
Pay the application processing fee per the campus instructions
Download your admit card and appear in the computer-based test
tests.note: Weights are percentages per the official FAST test pattern (BS CS/Engineering): Advanced Math 50%, Analytical Skills & IQ 20%, Basic Math 20%, English 10%. Negative marking applies; calculators are not allowed. Exact question counts are not published.

tests.name: LCAT — LUMS Common Admission Test (with SAT/ACT alternative)
acceptedBy: Suleman Dawood School of Business (BSc Accounting & Finance, Management Science)
Syed Babar Ali School of Science & Engineering (all BS programmes)
Mushtaq Ahmad Gurmani School of Humanities & Social Sciences
Shaikh Ahmad Hassan School of Law (BA-LLB, together with the HEC LAT)
tests.fee: PKR 6,500 LCAT registration fee plus PKR 11,500 application processing fee (local applicants)
tests.frequency: Once a year (February, with the undergraduate admission cycle)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Create an account on the LUMS online admission portal
Submit the undergraduate application and select LCAT as your test option
Pay the application processing and LCAT registration fee via the voucher
Download your admit card and appear in the paper-based test
Check your application status and admission decision online
tests.note: MCQ-based paper assessing verbal and quantitative skills; SAT or ACT scores may be submitted instead. Exact section question counts are not published officially.

tests.name: IBA Aptitude Test (Undergraduate Admission Test)
acceptedBy: IBA Karachi BBA and BS Business Analytics
IBA Karachi BS (Accounting & Finance), BS Economics, BS Social Sciences
IBA Karachi BS (Computer Science), BS Mathematics, BS Economics & Mathematics
IBA Karachi BS (Economics & Data Science)
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (paid via bank challan after submitting the online form)
tests.frequency: Twice a year (Round 1 and Round 2 test dates per admission cycle)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Fill the online application form on the IBA admissions portal (onlineadmission.iba.edu.pk)
Print the bank challan and deposit the admission processing fee
Receive your admit card by email and SMS on the announced dates
Appear in the aptitude test at your selected test city
Qualify for group discussion and interview if you pass the test
tests.note: Two components per the official criteria: Mathematics (MCQs) and English Composition (MCQs) at SAT-I difficulty level. Top SAT scorers may qualify for test exemption under IBA's published policy.

tests.name: GIKI Undergraduate Admission Test
tests.conductingBody: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology (GIKI)
acceptedBy: GIKI BS Engineering programmes (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Materials and related)
GIKI BS Computing programmes: Computer Science, AI, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Data Science
GIKI BS Management Sciences
tests.fee: PKR 3,500 for a single test; PKR 5,000 for both tests (+PKR 1,000 if applying for financial assistance)
tests.frequency: Once a year (July test window; 6–10 July 2026)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Register on the GIKI admissions portal (admissions.giki.edu.pk) and fill the form
Pay the processing fee via challan, 1Bill or HBL online banking
Email the proof of payment with your admit card number to ug.payment@giki.edu.pk
Appear in the online admission test on your scheduled date
tests.note: Intermediate-level MCQs in Mathematics, Physics and English; separate Engineering/Computing and Management Sciences papers. Exact question counts are not published on the official page.

tests.name: COMSATS University Islamabad Admission Test (NTS NAT based)
tests.conductingBody: COMSATS University Islamabad (CUI) via NTS NAT and CUI on-campus tests
acceptedBy: COMSATS University Islamabad campuses: Islamabad, Abbottabad, Lahore, Sahiwal, Wah, Attock, Vehari
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (NTS NAT fee approx. PKR 1,510 in the 2025 cycle plus university processing fee)
tests.frequency: Multiple test dates per admission cycle (NTS NAT series plus CUI on-campus tests)
tests.validity: NAT result valid for 1 year (per NTS)

syllabus.subject: Subject (NAT-IE)
topics: Physics: mechanics, electricity and modern physics

howToApply: Apply online through the CUI admission system (admissions.comsats.edu.pk)
Register for the required NTS NAT type or the CUI on-campus entry test
Pay the test and application processing fees as instructed
Check your merit position after NAT scores and academic marks are combined
tests.note: CUI uses NTS NAT (e.g., NAT-IE for Pre-Engineering, NAT-ICS for ICS) and also conducts its own on-campus entry tests. NAT pattern: 90 MCQs, 120 minutes, per the official NTS paper pattern.

tests.name: NTS NAT — National Aptitude Test
acceptedBy: NTS-associated universities and degree-awarding institutes across Pakistan
COMSATS University Islamabad and other universities requiring NAT scores
tests.fee: Announced per series (approx. PKR 1,510 in the 2025 cycle)
tests.frequency: Multiple series per year (NAT-IX series ran in 2026)
howToApply: Register on the NTS online registration portal (nts.org.pk) for the open NAT series
Download the bank deposit slip and pay the test fee at a partner bank
Receive your roll number slip and appear in the test
Share your NAT result card with universities while applying for admission
tests.note: Category One (12-year education): 90 MCQs, 120 minutes — English 20, Analytical 20, Quantitative 20, Subject 30. The subject section and NAT type depend on the candidate's group (IE, IM, ICS, ICOM, IA, IGS). Verified from the official NTS paper pattern.

tests.name: PIEAS Admission Test (BS Programs)
tests.conductingBody: Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences (PIEAS)
acceptedBy: PIEAS BS engineering programmes (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical and related)
PIEAS BS science programmes (Physics, Mathematics and related)
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (approx. PKR 3,500 in the 2026 cycle)
tests.frequency: Once a year (after the BS application deadline in the admission cycle)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Apply online through the PIEAS admissions portal (red.pieas.edu.pk)
Fill the application form and select your preferred BS programme
Pay the processing fee via the prescribed bank challan
Download your admit card and appear in the written test
tests.note: Per the official test pattern PDF: 100 MCQs, 3 hours, no negative marking, with stream-wise section splits. Exact per-section counts vary by programme and are published in the official pattern document.

tests.name: AKU Admission Test (Aga Khan University)
acceptedBy: Aga Khan University Medical College (5-year MBBS, Karachi)
Aga Khan University School of Nursing and Midwifery (BScN)
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (PKR 7,000 application processing fee in the 2025 cycle)
tests.frequency: Once a year (2026–27 applications closed 13 May 2026)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken
howToApply: Complete the online application on the AKU admissions portal
Pay the application processing fee via HBL or debit/credit card
Submit your academic records and required documents
Appear in the AKU admission test on the announced date
Attend an interview if shortlisted based on test performance
tests.note: The official admission booklet describes a Science Achievement section (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) plus Science & Mathematical Reasoning. Passing the PM&DC MDCAT is also mandatory for MBBS applicants.

tests.name: LAT — Law Admission Test
tests.conductingBody: Higher Education Commission (HEC) via the Education Testing Council (ETC)
acceptedBy: All HEC-recognized universities and law colleges offering the 5-year LLB across Pakistan
LUMS Shaikh Ahmad Hassan School of Law (BA-LLB, together with LCAT/SAT/ACT)
tests.fee: Announced per intake (approx. PKR 1,800 in the 2025 cycle)
tests.frequency: Multiple intakes per year (2026 tests: 21 June and 6 September)
howToApply: Create an account on the HEC ETC portal (etc.hec.gov.pk) with CNIC/B-Form and email
Complete your personal and academic profile and upload a photograph
Select Law Admission Test (LAT) and choose your test centre
Pay the fee via the 1Link 1Bill consumer ID (mobile banking, ATM or EasyPaisa)
Download your roll number slip about a week before the test
tests.note: 100-mark paper: 75 MCQs plus essay (15 marks) and personal statement (10 marks); passing mark is 50. Pattern per the HEC LAT notification; HEC states the LAT result is valid for two years.

tests.name: NUMS — National University of Medical Sciences Entry Test
acceptedBy: NUMS constituent and affiliated medical and dental colleges
Public-sector medical colleges that admit through the NUMS entry test
tests.fee: Announced per cycle (approx. PKR 4,500–6,500 for local candidates)
tests.validity: Valid for the admission cycle in which it is taken

syllabus.subject: Biology
topics: Human physiology: circulation, respiration, digestion, homeostasis

syllabus.subject: Chemistry
topics: Physical chemistry: gases, equilibrium, kinetics, thermochemistry

howToApply: Register online on the official NUMS admission portal when the cycle opens
Fill the application form and choose your preferred test city
Upload your photograph and required documents
Pay the registration fee and download your admit card
tests.note: 200 MCQs — 150 academic (Biology 55, Chemistry 40, Physics 40, English 15) plus 50 psychological questions, 3 hours, no negative marking. Multiple past papers are offered as separate practice tests.
